status_assessment.basis: The Anglican Diocese of Christchurch's Anglican Life directory lists St Chad's Church—Linwood, 1 Carnarvon Street, as a church of the Linwood-Aranui Parish. It describes a 'strong worship base' and weekly activities. That page has no date. I found no closure, sale or deconsecration evidence in the sources I could open. The last OSM edit (2026-03-21) keeps the place-of-worship tagging. Search-engine summaries of parish pages I could not open also describe current weekly services and say the church stayed open after the 2010–2011 earthquakes. The status is not rated 'active' because no dated primary source confirms services in 2026.
status_assessment.osm_stale_basis: The current OSM tags (place_of_worship, christian, anglican, 1 Carnarvon Street, Linwood, 8062) match the diocesan listing. Two small issues remain. The name includes 'North Linwood' where the diocese says 'Linwood'. And start_date=2007 is probably a typo for 1907 (unverified lead). Neither changes whether the record describes an active Anglican church at this site.

run_manifest.notes: claude session 296ae86b-a436-4c40-b029-94bef6bbc851; num_turns 22; permission_denials 0 | I used all fifteen fetches. Several key pages would not load: the parish website (404), its /about page (404), neighbourly.co.nz (406), CINCH (403), canterburystories.nz (403) and DigitalNZ (403). The Papers Past search pages came back with no readable content, and the Anglican Life church-names PDF could not be parsed. So I have no verified founding or building dates. Leads from search-engine result summaries only (pages not opened, so not cited as evidence): (a) the first St Chad's was opened by Bishop Julius on 24 February 1907, with the first service on Easter Day, 31 March 1907; (b) it was part of Avonside parish until 1919, when it became a parish in its own right; (c) in 1923 the church was moved across the paddocks to its present site at 1 Carnarvon Street; (d) the 2010–2011 earthquakes caused some damage but the buildings stayed open; (e) the St Ambrose (Aranui) congregation merged its finances with St Chad's, and the parish was renamed from Linwood to Linwood-Aranui. These leads suggest the OSM start_date=2007 is a typo for 1907. A reviewer should check them against Papers Past (for example, Press or Lyttelton Times reports from February–March 1907 and 1923), the Anglican Life church-names PDF, and the St Ambrose centennial publication (canterburystories.nz ccl-cs-116539). The rendered OSM history page and the API disagree on which version changed the suburb; I followed the API, which puts it in v5. I left out the OSM phone tag and the contact details found in search results, as instructed.
